vetSays.line: 🛡️ the person in their 40s, the man in his 50s, with a gap-toothed grin, Mwaluma and the woman in her 60s met them at the door — 4 put down. the person in their 40s, the man in his 50s, with a gap-toothed grin, Mwaluma, the woman in her 60s are hurt.
🛡️ Tom, Mwaluma and Bautista met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Tom, Mwaluma are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Hunter, Tom and Mwaluma met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Mwaluma didn't come back. Hunter, Tom are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hunter just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hunter, Tom, Bautista, Leo and Lena met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Hunter, Tom, Bautista, Leo, Lena are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Hunter, Lena, Miguel and Nikos met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Hunter didn't come back. Lena, Miguel, Nikos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lena just put down Gavel... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elif, Jesse and Nina met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Elif, Jesse, Nina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jesse, Onni and Alexander met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Jesse, Onni, Alexander are hurt.
